en.blurb_leader: %{name} is the leader of %{clan}Clan. The guardianship of all Clan dragons has been entrusted to them by The Great Wyrm. The leader is the highest authority in the Clan. The leader holds Clan meetings, determines mentors for new trainees, and names new warriors. To help them protect the Clan, The Great Wyrm has given them nine lives. They typically take the title "-The Leader".
en.blurb_deputy: %{name} is %{clan}Clan's deputy. The deputy is the second in command, just below the leader. They advise the leader and organize daily patrols, alongside normal warrior duties. Typically, a deputy is personally appointed by the current leader. As dictated by the Warrior Code, all deputies must train at least one trainee before appointment. The deputy succeeds the leader if they die or retire.
en.blurb_warrior: %{name} is a warrior. Warriors are adult dragons who feed and protect their Clan. They are trained to hunt and fight in addition to the ways of the Warrior Code. Warriors are essential to the survival of a Clan, and usually make up the bulk of its members.
en.blurb_elder: %{name} is an elder. They have spent many moons serving their Clan, and have earned many moons of rest. Elders are essential to passing down the oral tradition of the Clan. Sometimes, dragons may retire due to disability or injury. Whatever the circumstance of their retirement, elders are held in high esteem in the Clan and always eat before warriors and medics.
en.blurb_medicine_cat: %{name} is a medic. Medics are the healers of the Clan. They treat injuries and illnesses with herbal remedies. Unlike warriors, medics are not expected to hunt and fight for the Clan. In addition to their healing duties, medics also have a special connection to The Great Wyrm. Every half-moon, they travel to their Clan's holy place to commune with The Great Wyrm.
en.blurb_mediator: %{name} is a diplomat. Diplomats are not typically required to hunt or fight for the Clan. Rather, diplomats are charged with handling disagreements between Clanmates and disputes between Clans. Some diplomats train as trainees to serve their Clan, while others may choose to become diplomats later in life.
en.blurb_apprentice: %{name} is a trainee, in training to become a warrior. Hatchlings can be made warrior trainees at six moons of age, where they will learn how to hunt and fight for their Clan. Typically, the training of an trainee is entrusted to a single warrior - their mentor. To build character, trainees are often assigned the unpleasant and grunt tasks of Clan life. Trainees usually take on the suffix "-The Winglet".
en.blurb_medcat_app: %{name} is a medic trainee, training to become a full medic. Hatchlings can be made medic trainees at six moons of age, where they will learn how to heal their Clanmates and commune with The Great Wyrm. Medic trainees are typically chosen for their interest in healing and/or their connecting to The Great Wyrm. Trainees usually take on the suffix "-The Winglet".
en.blurb_mediator_app: %{name} is a diplomat trainee, training to become a full diplomat. Diplomats are in charge of handling disagreements both within the Clan and between Clans. Diplomat trainees are often chosen for their quick thinking and steady personality. Trainees usually take on the suffix "-The Winglet".
en.blurb_kitten: %{name} is a hatchling. All dragons below the age of six moons are considered hatchlings. Hatchlings are prohibited from leaving camp in order to protect them from the dangers of the wild. Although they don't have any official duties in the Clan, they are expected to learn the legends and traditions of their Clan. They are protected by every dragon in the Clan and always eat first. Hatchlings usually do not have a title.
en.blurb_newborn: %{name} is an egg. The dragons of the clan are expected to protect their most vulnerable and valuable of members, eggs being the top of this list. They are watched closely by the queens of the clan, and will be protected at all costs as any careless soul could crush the invaluable egg.
en.blurb_unknown: %{name} has an unknown rank. I guess they want to make their own way in life!
